capabilities: Track STATs, skills, HP, wounds and Death Saves
Roll d10 skill checks with crit and fumble results
Apply damage with armor SP ablation and wound penalties
Run a character creation wizard for lifepath, STATs, skills, gear and cyberware
Spend Improvement Points on skills and Rank
disambiguation: Not a rules reference or statblock library; the repository ships no rulebook text, stat blocks, pregenerated characters or art.
extras: Unofficial content under R. Talsorian Games' Homebrew Content Policy, not approved or endorsed by RTG; the plugin makes no network requests, but the optional CSS snippet loads three Google Fonts. Requires Obsidian 1.9 or newer for the Bases core plugin. Installation is manual (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css into the plugin folder) or via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track and roll a Cyberpunk RED character sheet, so players must keep stats, damage and armor outside their notes.

relations.evidence: Fantasy Statblocks → Layouts → Import From JSON
The note properties (hp, hp_current, ref, sp_head, sp_body, conditions, type) are compatible with it.
Homepage: optional, to open Home.md on start.
Alternatively, install it with the BRAT plugin: Add beta plugin

summary: Interactive Cyberpunk RED character sheet plugin with STATs, d10 skill rolls, HP and wounds, armor ablation, weapons, cyberware, lifepath, IP upgrades and a phone layout.
